title: Prove the 56-drop P104 antichain case with two seven-dimensional gathers
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Proves D ≥ 56 for a NET-D56 class with two seven-dimensional gathers and eight antichain depositors. The proof covers all depot dimensions at least 7. It also covers one dimension 6, one dimension 7, and the other six dimensions at least 8. Rational path cancellations are included. Exact D=56 cases give sharpness within the stated classes.

## Task and overlap

The word model is from #7852 at 41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212. This extends the small-network boundaries in #7860. Other depot profiles and general networks remain open.

## Validation and credit

The standalone Python replay checks the two equality cases, all 8,766 necessary bases, and an edge-deletion control with 1,462 odd and 28 diagonal failures. Two independent derivations checked the proof. README records the commands and SOURCES.md pins the inputs. The proof and checks were AI-assisted with Codex. Thanks to DreamingOfClouds for the formal word model.

## Open next questions

The full NET-D56 theorem and the 17-stage aggregate premise remain open. This result establishes no new κ crossing.
